svg.title: 스파 해수랑 조감도
svg.desc: Bird's-eye hand drawing of Spa Haesurang in Busan, floor plans seen from above: the 7th-floor open-air bath, Finnish sauna, lounge bar and PDR rooms, the 5th-floor jjimjil room and lockers, the 4th-floor lockers and powder room, and the 2nd-floor lobby with the 3rd-floor powder room.
